thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: PD#789012 - p99 latency >1200ms for route /v1/generate (EU-WEST). Autoscaler considered. Link: https://dash.redwood.ai/alerts/789012
pagerduty: Page fired -> urgent, notify escalation policy 'oncall-sre'.
maria: ack - I'm on it :raised_hand:
josh: ack — looking at telemetry, p99 spike starting 12:00UTC, KV cache evictions + sudden rate jump from acme-app.
meena: which model/route? any recent rollouts?
alex: rollout v2.3.1 to EU-west at 11:58, only 30% traffic
josh: logs show repeated kv-miss and OOM evictions on sidecar; sidecar mem spiking.
ops-bot: autoscaler attempted +2 replicas but hit quota, scaled to 4 -> rejected for burst.
maria: trying quick mitigation: bump dedicated pool size and warm KV cache. executing:
```
redwoodctl pool resize --name dedicated-eu --replicas 6
./scripts/warm_kvcache.sh --route /v1/generate --workers 8
```
josh: suggest also temporary routing to fallback model (v2.2.quant) to reduce mem. config patch:
```
route: /v1/generate
fallback_model: redwood/v2.2.quant
fallback_policy: prefer-fallback-if-slo>1000ms
```
meena: notifying support: Acme Corp problem? they started sending long contexts.
support: Acme reporting many timeouts ~40% for last 5m, support ticket 9876 created.
alex: monitoring p99 now, initial after scale warmup p99 still 1100ms.
maria: warmup loop started, status: 20% kv warm after 30s.
josh: I pushed temporary reroute for 20% traffic to v2.2.quant.
ops-bot: quota cleared after admin uplift, resize succeeded -> replicas=6
maria: p99 trending down 12:04UTC -> 420ms
meena: nice. any customer errors still?
support: Acme timeouts dropped to 5% now, they've acknowledged mitigation.
josh: recommend keeping replicas=6 for 15min and monitor; prepare to rollback rollout if regression reappears.
maria: agreed. I'm updating PD and closing if stable.
pagerduty: Page acknowledged by maria; status: in_progress.
maria: marking as mitigated — p99 stabilized ~210-260ms for 5m window. I'll leave scaling and warmup in place and file postmortem.
incident-bot: Incident mitigation: temporary pool bump + fallback routing + kv warmup. Creating incident record #INC-2026-45.
alex: thanks team. handoff to day SRE for followup at 12:30UTC.
maria: handing off to josh for follow-up and postmortem.
josh: taking handoff. will capture timelines and RCA.
pagerduty: Page resolved by maria.
